feed.title: Album of the day on deezer

entry.summary: This album has been a slow grower on me this year. First only the amazing(!) title track caught my... ear... But now, after many a listen, I relly enjoy the whole album. Greatful Dead-ish. In a good way.
entry.title: 2026-06-25: Arboretum -- Let It All In (2020)

entry.summary: Nearing halfway through the year, so it's time to highlight some favourite discoveries. This is the 2020 album I have listened the most to, methinks. Ole Paus with Motorpsycho as a backing band. Amazing.
entry.title: 2026-06-26: Ole Paus -- Så nær, så nær (2020)

entry.summary: Ole Paus is by some considered a kind of Norwegian Bob Dylan, and, fittingly the 79 years old(!) Dylan also relased an amazing album this year!
